input.instruction: Hero centerpiece — massive holographic portal frame, the visual anchor of the hero section. Ornate cast-bronze ring etched with deep ancient runes, turquoise plasma flowing along the rune channels. The interior of the frame shows a swirling cosmic nebula running as an i2v keyframe loop (method 3, 30 frames @ 30fps): purple-and-magenta gas clouds, distant stars rotating slowly, occasional bright pulse from within. Idle pulse + i2v loop. The single most ornate object in the composition.
